method: Seven graph-v2 samples per independent process; seven fixed stages with paired plain/aligned compilation per IR and plain-original recheck.
Each candidate is validated against the exact original fixture and FP64 bounds; no oracle adjustment.
Compile wall includes IR transformation and diagnostic receipt writing; it is not isolated compiler overhead.
Recorded readonly/guard checks are distinct from independently rechecked saved full outputs.
Sample range overlap is descriptive, not a significance test; no confidence/model selection claim.
Actual CUfunction/grid/block/shared/four pointers are observed on every node of the timed graph; live launches use full numerical checks, not a device trace.
Loaded-entry resource attributes are recorded, not interpreted as physical thread counts, occupancy, spill traffic or a performance cause.
telemetry_scope: Whole-stage telemetry includes compilation, upload, warmup and measurements; no automatic causal attribution.
original_summary_scope: Standalone V5 alignment isolation with frozen V4 streamed SUM IR; no production selection or Torch comparison
